Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 1733/2025

Dear Ms. Mukherjee,

Thank you for meeting us on 15 May 2026 about your dispute with Priyanka DSouza. As we understand it, the occupant claims ownership by adverse possession. The matter is listed before the Pune District Court.

Our advice is to rebut the adverse possession claim with tax receipts showing continuous ownership. Please collect tax receipts showing continuous ownership and electricity bills and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
